We are delighted to share that the Vidyadhan program has been honored with the prestigious Humanitarian Excellence Award 2025 by the I Can Foundation. We dedicate this recognition to our sponsors, partners, and, most importantly, to our students, who remain the true heroes of our journey.
The Humanitarian Excellence Award 2025 was presented in New Delhi on the occasion of
India's 79th Independence Day (August 15, 2025) by former Coal Minister Shri Santosh
Bagrodia ji, in recognition of Vidyadhan's unwavering commitment to empowering bright,
This recognition inspires us to further pursue our mission and continue reaching out to deserving students across India.

We are delighted to share that the Vidyadhan program has been honored with the Award of Excellence in Education and Skill Development (NGO Category) at the FKCCI India CSR & Sustainability Conference & Awards 2025.
The award was presented by the Honorable Home Minister of Karnataka, Shri G. Parameshwar,
and we dedicate this recognition to our sponsors, partners, and the students who continue to inspire us every day.
Presented by the Federation of Karnataka Chambers of Commerce & Industry (FKCCI),
Karnataka's premier voice for industry, trade, and services, this award celebrates the
transformative impact Vidyadhan is creating through education and skill development.

This recognition is a testament to the dedication, commitment, and shared vision of our entire community. It motivates us to continue our mission of enabling bright, economically underprivileged students to achieve their full potential.

"I decided to pursue engineering at Bangalore when the norm in my village was to send
girls to nearby degree colleges or get them married. I wanted to show everybody that a
girl can be a successful professional and also take care of family."
Vidyadhan scholarship enabled her to pursue that dream and gave her confidence about
reaching her goal. The transition to a Bangalore engineering college was not easy
given she studied in Kannada medium at school. "The training given by Vidyadhan helped
me a lot to be a confident speaker and face interviews successfully".
Apoorva is also a talented Yakshagana artist who has performed across Karnataka.
